summary: Faz 8 CP6 (Multi-company + Orphan Tasks + 3-mode delete + Cross-manager consent) full-stack tested. Backend: 15/15 new test_multi_company.py pytests GREEN (TestCompanyMembers 4, TestOrphanTasks 4, TestUserDeleteModes 3, TestCrossCompanyFlow 4) + 94/94 regression (test_permissions 20, test_tasks 22, test_team_faz2 10, test_task_reassign 5, test_task_categories 8, test_workspace_and_company 16, test_due_soon 13) = 109/109 total. Frontend Playwright verified: (a) Sidebar tab-orphans present for admin+manager, HIDDEN for employee (RBAC visibility correct). (b) OrphanTasksPanel empty state 'SİCİLİN TEMİZ' renders via [data-testid=orphan-empty]. (c) Admin → Ayarlar → Kullanıcılar → admin-delete-{username} opens delete-user-modal with all 3 modes (delete-mode-soft = 'ADINI KORU (ÖNERİLEN)', delete-mode-purge = 'TAM SIL (KVKK)', delete-mode-hard = 'NÜKLEER SIL (DİKKAT!)') and delete-confirm button. (d) Companies management → expand → perm-toggle-{Ca}-to-{Cb} 3-state cycles GÖRMÜYOR → GÖRÜR (admin instant-active) → GÖRMÜYOR (revoke) verified live. Cross-tenant isolation validated in backend test_manager_sees_own_company_orphans_only (manager A does NOT see manager B's orphans).

issues: When the Companies (ŞİRKETLER) subtab is on and the tabs row wraps to 2 lines, the top-level tabs 'RENKLER/TEMALAR/ALARM/HESAP/MOD/UYARILAR/KULLANICILAR' overlap slightly at 1920px viewport — visible in screenshot admin_delete_modal.png. Cosmetic only, all buttons remain clickable.

critical_code_review_comments: CompaniesManagement.jsx uses c.name in data-testid (perm-toggle-{name}-to-{name}) — company names with spaces (e.g., 'Test Company A') produce spaces in testids which is legal but fragile; consider using company IDs for testids in future.

test_multi_company.py::TestOrphanTasks::test_reassign_orphan_clears_flags soft-passes even if self-visibility grant fails (only asserts when status_code==200). Consider explicit else-branch skip/xfail to avoid silent green.

test_multi_company._cleanup wipes ENTIRE company_permissions collection between test runs — safe in test env but risky if run against a shared DB; scope the deletion by viewer_company_id/target_company_id in CP6_ ids.
